story_overview: MSVBench story 28 (Japanese Children's Literature). Totto-chan and her mother are walking to the new school. Totto-chan is very interested in the train ticket and asks the ticket inspector uncle if she can keep it, but is refused. Totto-chan’s mother holds her hand as they walk, feeling uneasy because Totto-chan’s previous behavior at school had troubled the teachers, even leading to her expulsion. To her even greater amazement, there are six real train cars serving as classrooms in the schoolyard. Totto-chan feels as if she has stepped into a dream.

Totto-chan’s mother holds her hand as they walk, feeling uneasy because Totto-chan’s previous behavior at school had troubled the teachers, even leading to her expulsion. Morning, entrance of the new school, serene atmosphere, two large trees forming the school gate, the school name plate hanging from the branches, a gravel path on the ground, surrounded by green trees and flowers, sunlight filtering through the leaves. Totto-chan and her mother stand at the school gate. Totto-chan looks surprised, pointing at the school name plate with her right hand, while her mother smiles at her. When they arrive at the new school, Totto-chan is surprised to find that the school gate is made of two living trees, with the school name plate hanging crookedly from them. Totto-chan stands in the center of the schoolyard, looking astonished, her hands covering her mouth. In the background, the six train cars are neatly arranged, gleaming in the sunlight.
